scene: standing before a dark unlit lighthouse at night, salt wind pulling at his coat
an old brass storm-lantern glowing faint amber in fog, close-up still life
hands gripping a rail, knuckles white, ghostly repeated afterimages of the same gesture
eight identical fresh graves in a row under a folding starless sky, one open and empty
in a lamplit reading room past midnight, surrounded by open books, one page glowing faintly wrong
a battered journal filled with spiraling unreadable script, annotations crowding the margins, candlelight
a raised hand in a stillness gesture toward an unseen presence, dust motes frozen mid-air
a page of writhing script that hurts to look at, the letters casting shadows in the wrong direction
alone at a card table, dealing the same hand again, smoke hanging motionless in the air
a worn deck of playing cards fanned on green felt, tiny scratches on the backs catching lamplight
catching a falling card mid-air without looking at it, barroom blur behind
a debt collector in a long coat at the end of a hallway, ledger in hand, face in shadow, patient
mid-seance, reaching toward a darkness that reaches back, candle flames bending sideways
a small bronze hand-bell on dark velvet, its surface etched with hour markings, faint blue afterglow
her eyes reflecting a scene that has not happened yet, the room around her dissolving
a grandfather clock with its hands spinning backward, shadow spilling from the open case like water
on an empty night road at the edge of town, glancing back over her shoulder, distant lit windows
a small brass compass in an open palm, needle pointing at nothing on the map beneath
slipping through a closing door of light, reaching hands just missing her coat
a crowd of townsfolk looking straight through the viewer, one empty space where a person should be
a chess move played before the opponent's hand has left the piece, afterimages of futures
the same doorway twice in one image, mirrored, a single figure entering both
hands performing a delicate task in total darkness, perfect and sure, faint motion trails
a night alley with an escape route chalk-marked in glowing lines only the viewer can see
a street map with one path burned through it, footsteps skipping impossible distances
an hourglass with sand flowing upward into the top bulb, cradled in careful hands
the same die frozen mid-tumble at five angles at once, one face beginning to glow
a single fixed lit window on a street where everything else blurs with motion
a notebook whose ink writes itself, the pages ahead already filled, pen hovering unheld
a name spoken as visible frost in the air, a vast shadow flinching back from it
a tall wrong silhouette at the far end of an empty street, too many angles, not quite arriving, featureless, dread, negative space
an ear-shaped ripple in the air over a sleeping town, words visible as thin black threads
a freestanding doorway in the town square, its far side showing the same square one hour later
a drowned figure in sodden vestments hauling a bell rope in a flooded belfry, water past its waist, the bell mid-swing
